_comment: python3 scripts/gen_client_surface_fixture.py 로 생성. 출처 = pytmuxlib/clientutil.py 의 카탈로그 + clientscreens.py 의 화면 클래스. 이 픽스처가 패리티(로드맵 G0)의 세는 단위다.

command_help.bind-key: prefix 후 키에 명령 바인딩 (bind-key <key> <command> · -n 은 prefix 없이 root)
command_help.choose-tree: 탭/패널 트리(전환·종료, 실행 앱·로컬/원격 표시. d/x=종료)
command_help.coalesce-repaints: 대량 출력 시 alt-screen 풀스크린 리페인트 합치기 on/off — ssh 반응성(coalesce-repaints on|off|toggle)
command_help.exit-empty: 세션이 0개여도 서버 종료 on/off — tmux exit-empty 동형, off=원격 federation 링크 보존용 상주(exit-empty on|off|toggle)
command_help.help: 전체 명령 목록 보기('?' 도 동일, 카테고리 탭)
command_help.merge-remote-tab: 같은 원격 서버의 다른 원격 탭을 현재 탭에 pane 으로 머지 (피커, 별칭 merge-remote) — §1.7 페더레이션
command_help.mouse-help: 마우스 제스처 도움말 팝업(헤더 드래그 swap·탭 드래그·Shift+선택 등, 별칭 mouse)
command_help.nest-auto-attach: 원격에서 pytmux 실행 시 거부 대신 자동 remote-attach 승격 on/off (nest-auto-attach on|off|toggle)
command_help.plugins: 플러그인 관리 — 설치된 플러그인 켜고/끄기(별칭 plugin-manager)
command_help.reconnect: IPC 강제 재접속 — degraded(빨간 외곽선) 고착 회복(서버 보존)
command_help.redraw: 화면 전체 강제 재그리기 (깨진/잔상 화면 회복; 별칭 refresh·refresh-client, prefix r)
command_help.remote-attach: 원격 pytmux 서버의 탭을 이 pytmux 에 어태치 (remote-attach <host>) — §1.7 페더레이션
command_help.remote-new-tab: 원격 pytmux 에 새 터미널을 만들어 새 탭으로 붙이기 (remote-new-tab <host>; 미어태치면 먼저 어태치)
command_help.restart-all: 전체 재시작 — 서버 세션유지 재시작 + 클라 재기동(별칭 full-restart). 서버·클라 코드 모두 갱신. 실행 전 드라이런 자동 점검, FAIL 시 재확인
command_help.restart-check: 독립 드라이런 — 실행 없이 안전성(re-exec·직렬화·fd·relaunch) 점검 팝업(별칭 restart-dry-run)
command_help.restart-server: 작업 보존 재시작 — 셸/PTY 를 살린 채 서버 코드만 교체(재접속). 실행 전 드라이런 자동 점검, FAIL 시 재확인
command_help.send-escape: 활성 패널에 ESC 전달 (Shift+ESC 안 먹는 터미널용 — bind-key 로 전용 키에 바인딩)
command_help.settings: 통합 설정 화면(모든 설정을 한 곳에서)
command_help.single-border: 패널이 하나뿐일 때 테두리 표시 on/off (single-border on|off|toggle)
command_help.strip-box-drawing: 붙여넣기 시 패널 테두리(박스드로잉) 제거 토글 [on|off]
command_help.swap-pane: 패널 위치 교환 (-U/-D 인접 · -s/-t 번호 임의)
command_help.vt-parser: VT 파서 백엔드 선택 pyte|native (재시작 시 발효 · vt-parser pyte|native)
command_help.win-mouse-motion: Windows 마우스 모션(any-motion) 패스스루 on/off — 기본 off(ConPTY 누출 방지) (win-mouse-motion on|off|toggle)
command_help.window-size: 다중 클라 미러링 시 공유 크기 규칙 smallest|latest|largest — latest=마지막 조작 창 크기(window-size smallest|latest|largest)

command_help_en.bind-key: Bind command to key after prefix (bind-key <key> <command> · -n = root, no prefix)
command_help_en.break-pane: Break pane into a new tab
command_help_en.capture-pane: Capture pane content to buffer (-S all)
command_help_en.coalesce-repaints: Coalesce alt-screen full repaints on heavy output on/off — ssh responsiveness (coalesce-repaints on|off|toggle)
command_help_en.commands: Show full command list (alias of help)
command_help_en.display-popup: Show command output in a popup
command_help_en.exit-empty: Exit server when session count hits 0 on/off — tmux exit-empty equivalent, off=stay resident for remote federation links (exit-empty on|off|toggle)
command_help_en.help: Show full command list ('?' too, category tabs)
command_help_en.join-pane: Join a pane from another tab (-h)
command_help_en.list-commands: Show full command list (alias of help)
command_help_en.merge-remote-tab: Merge another remote tab from the same server into the current tab as a pane (picker, alias merge-remote) — federation
command_help_en.mouse-help: Mouse gesture help popup (header-drag swap·tab drag·Shift+select etc., alias mouse)
command_help_en.nest-auto-attach: Auto-promote remote pytmux run to remote-attach instead of rejecting on/off (nest-auto-attach on|off|toggle)
command_help_en.new-tab: New tab (creates one new window, = new-window)
command_help_en.pin-tab: Pin tab (move to right zone · prevent accidental close)
command_help_en.pipe-pane: Pipe pane output to external command
command_help_en.plugins: Manage plugins — enable/disable installed plugins (alias plugin-manager)
command_help_en.reconnect: Force IPC reconnect — recover stuck degraded (red border) state (server preserved)
command_help_en.redraw: Force full screen redraw (recover broken/stale screen; aliases refresh·refresh-client, prefix r)
command_help_en.remote-attach: Attach a remote pytmux server's tabs into this one (remote-attach <host>) — federation
command_help_en.remote-new-tab: Spawn a new terminal on a remote pytmux and attach it as a new tab (remote-new-tab <host>; attaches first if needed)
command_help_en.restart-all: Full restart — server session-preserving restart + client relaunch (alias full-restart). Updates both server·client code. Auto dry-run first, re-confirm on FAIL
command_help_en.restart-check: Standalone dry-run — check safety (re-exec·serialize·fd·relaunch) without running, popup (alias restart-dry-run)
command_help_en.restart-server: Work-preserving restart — swap server code keeping shells/PTY (reconnect). Auto dry-run first, re-confirm on FAIL
command_help_en.select-pane: Move to pane (-L/-R/-U/-D) or set title (-T)
command_help_en.send-escape: Send ESC to active pane (for terminals where Shift+ESC fails — bind to a key with bind-key)
command_help_en.send-keys: Inject keys to pane (e.g. Enter, C-c)
command_help_en.settings: Unified settings screen (all settings in one place)
command_help_en.single-border: Show border when only one pane on/off (single-border on|off|toggle)
command_help_en.strip-box-drawing: Toggle stripping pane borders (box-drawing) on paste [on|off]
command_help_en.swap-pane: Swap pane position (-U/-D adjacent · -s/-t by number)
command_help_en.vt-parser: Select VT parser backend pyte|native (takes effect on restart · vt-parser pyte|native)
command_help_en.win-mouse-motion: Windows mouse motion (any-motion) passthrough on/off — default off (avoids ConPTY leak) (win-mouse-motion on|off|toggle)
command_help_en.window-size: Shared grid sizing rule for multi-client mirroring smallest|latest|largest — latest=size of last-operated client (window-size smallest|latest|largest)
